title: Course Blueprint v6 Three-Year Draft

assessment_structure.formal_test_week_model: one formal test week per book

test_preparation_policy.book_11_role: final exam training and cumulative integration, not a separate twelfth or thirteenth book

authority_notes: This is a draft umbrella blueprint for human review, not the active production baseline.
Course Blueprint v5 remains the active Year 1 / Books 1-4 source until this draft is reviewed and promoted.
The older three-year concept is useful planning input but is not canonical; it used a 13-book model and contains stale registry assumptions.
Official exam questions, correction models, reviewed target exercises, and CLI-backed registry changes remain stronger than owned prose.
